span.p:
Both cascades run in ProjectService, not in JPA:
trashing a project bulk-stamps removed_at on its media;
visibilityCascade=CASCADE pushes isVisibleToPublic
onto every media isPublic.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
All four media entities:
isPublic=false hides the row from guest APIs only,
staff still see it. removedAt is the separate trash
flag and hides it from everyone until admin restore.
